Container.Name: flock
Container.Overview:
Discovers and controls networked AV devices from one dashboard.
Note: This repo already had a hand-written Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml before this fleet sweep, and they are better informed than anything generated — in particular the note about Debian's ffmpeg possibly lacking SRT input support. The generator does NOT overwrite them. Only the CA template and the GHCR workflow are added here.
This container uses host networking because it discovers devices over mDNS/broadcast, which Docker's bridge network does not reliably forward. In bridge mode discovery finds nothing rather than reporting an error.
